params.command: Write-Output '===WORKERS==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'heaven.*worker|worker.py|heaven-desktop-worker' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CreationDate,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Format-List; Write-Output '===RUNTIME==='; $p='C:\Users\Xxkan\.mhw-local-tools\heaven-desktop-worker.py'; Select-String -Path $p -Pattern 'WORKER_VERSION|worker_version.: 2' | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object {$_.Line}; Write-Output '===BOOTLOG==='; if(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\HeavenBridge\bootstrap-v3-last.log") { Get-Content -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE\HeavenBridge\bootstrap-v3-last.log" -Encoding Unicode | Select-Object -Last 80 }; Write-Output '===STARTUP==='; Get-Content -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::Combine([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup'),'HeavenBridgeWorker.cmd')) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output '===TASK==='; Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'HeavenLocalBridge' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object TaskName,State | Format-List
